name: packaging-config
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace, or when later slices fold this into a full configure/run UX feature.
spec_change_reason: Cut release v0.30.0 (minor, loop-convergence fixes + open_pr implementer lib): bump _PLUGIN_VERSION 0.29.0 -> 0.30.0 and regenerate the committed plugin tree so it carries verify-integrate 0.11.1 + scheduling 0.44.0 + implement 0.11.0's sources — lib/verify_integrate.py (RECONCILE _pr_number tolerates a URL-form pr_ref so tier-1 conflict-recovery never crashes) and lib/run_tick.py (RECONCILE seed uses canonical owner/repo#N refs + a durable prior-verdicts snapshot that survives the fresh-tick reset). The build change registers open_pr.py (implement/src/open_pr.py) in build_plugin._LIBS — a pure-stdlib byte-for-byte lib like test_gate.py — so the shipped agents/auto-maintainer-implementer.md (v2.11.0) can invoke ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/open_pr.py; the agent md re-collects via the ship/ convention. The shipped default-config CONTENT is unchanged (still schema 2.9.0, same values). The version-assertion test advanced to 0.30.0, ship assertions added for lib/open_pr.py (byte-identical to source, no .rabbit leak), test/release_lib_baseline.json re-anchored (version -> 0.30.0, lib_digest -> the new committed-lib digest incl. open_pr.py), and the housekeep doc baseline re-anchored to the grown spec so the drift, #355 monotonicity, and doc-size guards stay green.
spec_no_change_reason: spec already updated to 0.7.20 (v0.30.0 release note) in preceding commit 8c13e3f; this cycle implements the build change + tree regen
